name: Petrify
overview: Runs Node relay automatically inside Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Party mode: stopping always keeps the host (the device that started the party) playing from the party position; mid-party playback claims no longer stop the host; sub-millisecond party clock.
Updated relay: party mode stop silences every device except the host, full library paging. Node shipped compressed, relay output drained, configurable port.
